points.description: Gives the purpose of testing significance: to check how well the model fits the observed data (goodness of fit) and/or to give the probability of rejecting the null hypothesis / judge whether results are reliable.
points.partial_credit: Half if the purpose is only vaguely stated (e.g. 'to check the model is accurate' or 'to test hypothesis').

points.description: Names the chi-square (X2) test as the test used.
points.partial_credit: Half if a related goodness-of-fit/statistical test is named (e.g. Kolmogorov-Smirnov, t-test) without chi-square.

rubric.notes: Full marks: the student says why (model fit to observed data / probability of rejecting the null hypothesis, any wording) and names the chi-square test. Part marks for a vague reason or for naming a different but related statistical test. Zero for a point if it is missing or unrelated; extra remarks do not lose marks.
